title: Je'zzee Wants Metal and Spit
description: Je'zzee Wants Metal and Spit — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Nielsen

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Continue killing Whisker Blademasters and Venomspitters in the lower branches of Frump's Misfortune to collect 20 Swords and 20 vials of Spit Juice and then return them to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Nielsen

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Frump's Misfortune

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Continue killing Whisker Blademasters and Venomspitters in the lower branches of Frump's Misfortune to collect 20 Swords and 20 vials of Spit Juice and then return them to Nielsen in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

Je'zzee Jaym'zz is acting like a diva that didn't have their pre-dungeon run demands met. Luckily he isn't asking for things like: brown candies having to be removed from eco-friendly seal skin pouches or for some crazy bottled water that can only be found in Rattle Tooth's Lair.

Je'zzee is again asking to be supplied with more blademaster swords and spit juice. For this, we are asking that you travel back into lower branches of Frump's Misfortune to collect 20 Swords from the Divine Whisker Blademasters and 20 vials of Spit Juice from the Divine Whisker Venomspitters and then return them to Nielson in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

It seems like there is just never enough. More more more, always wanting more. If you want to make some more money, let Nielsen know you are ready to do more work.

Objectives:

  • Blademaster Swords ×20
  • Spit Juice ×20

Level range: 25–45
